comments: Configuration for the VAMS v2.6 to v2.7 migration (orphaned workflow-trigger cleanup + vector index backfill + system-pipeline retirement report). The single script v2.6_to_v2.7_migration.py runs all steps; select one with --steps.
_comment_prefix: Required: SSM resource-name base prefix from the CDK core stack output 'ResourceNamesSSMParamPrefixOutput' (format: /{configName}-{baseStackName}/resourceNames). Every table and function name below is resolved from it; the explicit overrides are only needed when the prefix is not filled in.
_comment_triggers: Deletes WorkflowTriggersStorageTable rows whose workflow is archived, missing, or one of the two retired built-ins (genai-metadata-3d-labeling-obj-glb-fbx-ply-stl-usd, metadata-extraction-cad-mesh under GLOBAL). Idempotent. DELETES ROWS, so the account-id confirmation applies.
_comment_vector: Invokes the deployed vectorReindexer Lambda (SSM key lambdaFunctions/vectorReindexer; published only when app.vectorSearch.enabled is true). clear_vectors=false re-embeds every latest live file in place (reindexer operation 'enqueue'); clear_vectors=true deletes every stored vector first (operation 'both'). Under --steps all the step is skipped with a warning when the function is not published (or, with neither the prefix nor this override set, cannot be resolved); under --steps vectorBackfill that is an error.
_comment_retirement: Lists executions of the retired workflows that are still in flight and user workflows that reference a retired pipeline id, with guidance. Writes nothing. workflow_storage_table_name_v2 above is reused.
_comment_safety: ===== Shared safety options (apply to every step) =====
_comment_aws: AWS configuration (optional - override with CLI flags)
_comment_instructions: How to use this configuration file
_instructions: === SETUP ===
1. Deploy the v2.7 CDK stack first. The deploy archives the retired built-ins, creates the vector
table and index, registers the system pipeline, and publishes the resource names to SSM.
2. Get the SSM resource-name base prefix from the CDK core stack outputs:
aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name your-vams-stack \
--query 'Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==`ResourceNamesSSMParamPrefixOutput`].OutputValue' \
--output text
3. Set 'resource_names_ssm_param_prefix' in this file to that value, and set 'aws_region' (and
'aws_profile' if needed). Every table name and the vectorReindexer function name are then
resolved automatically from SSM Parameter Store.
=== EXECUTION (single consolidated script; --steps selects which step to run, default all) ===
4. Dry run first (HIGHLY RECOMMENDED), all steps:
python v2.6_to_v2.7_migration.py --config v2.6_to_v2.7_migration_config.json --dry-run
5. Production migration, all steps (prompts for the account id because orphanedTriggers deletes rows):
python v2.6_to_v2.7_migration.py --config v2.6_to_v2.7_migration_config.json
6. Run only one step if needed:
python v2.6_to_v2.7_migration.py --config v2.6_to_v2.7_migration_config.json --steps orphanedTriggers
python v2.6_to_v2.7_migration.py --config v2.6_to_v2.7_migration_config.json --steps vectorBackfill
python v2.6_to_v2.7_migration.py --config v2.6_to_v2.7_migration_config.json --steps systemPipelineRetirement
7. (Vector rebuild only) Clear every stored vector before re-embedding:
python v2.6_to_v2.7_migration.py --config v2.6_to_v2.7_migration_config.json --steps vectorBackfill --clear-vectors
=== WHAT THIS DOES ===
orphanedTriggers: enumerates every fileUpload trigger row through TriggersByBaseTypeGSI, joins it to
WorkflowStorageTableV2, and deletes rows whose workflow is archived or missing - including the two
retired built-ins' triggers, which otherwise keep firing into '400 Workflow is archived'.
vectorBackfill: invokes the deployed vectorReindexer with {operation: enqueue|both, dryRun, limit}. The
reindexer enumerates the latest live version of every file and enqueues one system-workflow
execution per file (paced by app.vectorSearch.indexingConcurrency). The step returns when the work is
ENQUEUED; watch progress with: vamscli execution list --workflow-database-id GLOBAL
--workflow-id system-genai-metadata --trigger-type System-Reindex --status RUNNING
systemPipelineRetirement: reports in-flight executions of the retired workflows (they turn FAILED after
their task timeout) and user workflows still referencing a retired pipeline id. Read-only.
=== SAFETY ===
- dry_run: orphanedTriggers names each row it would delete; vectorBackfill passes dryRun to the reindexer;
systemPipelineRetirement is unaffected (it only reads)
- limit: caps trigger rows examined / files enqueued / rows listed per report section (testing only)
- clear_vectors: vectorBackfill only; defaults to false; natural-language search returns nothing between
the clear and the completion of the re-embedding executions
- Every step is safe to repeat: orphanedTriggers finds nothing on a second run, vectorBackfill overwrites
the same vector items and the system workflow's perInputFileVersion lock drops a duplicate launch,
systemPipelineRetirement writes nothing.
